daily_reality.typical_workday: Patient consultations and spinal adjustments throughout the day. Typical schedule 30-40 hours per week in direct patient care. Review patient histories, perform examinations, order and interpret diagnostic imaging (X-rays). Document treatments in EHR. Administrative tasks: billing, insurance claims, practice management. Many own their own practices, combining clinical work with business operations.
key_documents: Patient intake forms and health histories
daily_reality.deadlines: Continuing education credits for license renewal (varies by state, typically every 1-2 years). Insurance claim filing deadlines. State license renewal cycles. Documentation must be completed same-day for compliance.
daily_reality.seasonality: Steady patient flow year-round. Slight increases after holidays (New Year's resolutions), sports seasons, and seasonal activities. Practice building efforts often tied to community events and health fairs.

laws_and_standards: Scope of practice limitations (varies by state)
regulatory.licensing: Doctor of Chiropractic (DC) degree from accredited chiropractic college required (4-year doctoral program after undergraduate). National Board of Chiropractic Examiners (NBCE) exams (Parts I-IV). State-specific licensing through state chiropractic boards. Continuing education required for renewal (varies by state). Some states allow additional modalities (acupuncture, physiotherapy).
regulatory.penalties: License suspension or revocation for non-compliance. Malpractice liability. State board disciplinary actions for scope violations. Insurance fraud penalties. New 2026 malpractice laws in several states changing damage limits.

software: PayDC - chiropractic-specific EHR and practice management

fears: Scope of practice encroachment from PTs and other providers
Student loan debt burden ($150k-250k for DC degree)
career_psychology.motivation: Helping patients with pain relief without drugs or surgery; practice ownership and entrepreneurial freedom; flexible schedules; holistic health philosophy. Income scales with experience — chiropractors in 50s average ~$148k vs $75k in 30s.
career_psychology.burnout: Lower burnout compared to physicians; physical demands of performing adjustments all day; administrative burden of insurance claims; isolation in solo practice. Flexibility in scheduling is a protective factor.

conferences: Parker Seminars - Las Vegas (major CE event)

market.job_count_estimate: About 38,300 chiropractors employed in the US (BLS). Most are in private practice (solo or small group). Growing number employed by health systems and multidisciplinary clinics.
market.work_arrangements: Predominantly private practice (solo or small group). Growing integration into health systems, VA hospitals, and multidisciplinary clinics. Telehealth expanding for consultations. Flexible scheduling is a major perk.
trends: New diagnosis codes for 2026 (abdominal/pelvic pain, remote monitoring)
Income growth with optimism in profession
All-in-one EHR platforms streamlining practice management
